text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"varied sentence openings and transitions such as \"First,\" \"Next,\" \"However,\" and \"In conclusion\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a clear progression with signposted paragraphs and a recognizable argumentative structure."},{"evidence":"\"Your imagination is vast; an open plain of wondrous ideas and possibilities\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"The writing develops points with richer explanation and more fully extended support."},{"evidence":"\"Creativity leads to creativity\" / \"not only can you find the best road to a goal, but you can spread the knowledge to others\"","quality":"sophistication of expression","description":"The essay uses more mature, varied phrasing and more ambitious sentence patterns to express its ideas."},{"evidence":"\"rough drawings by cavemen\" \"Beowulf and The Odyssey\" \"Damascus steel\"","quality":"specific supporting examples","description":"The essay relies on more concrete, varied examples to strengthen its claims."},{"evidence":"\"the forging process for the metal has been lost\"","quality":"content control","description":"The essay shows a stronger ability to stay on topic while developing relevant detail without drifting as much into repetition or awkward digressions."},{"evidence":"\"while knowledge is powerful, imagination can make it far stronger\"","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay more clearly builds and qualifies a position by introducing counterclaims and responding to them."}]}
